page_title: ATA 1-1 JUV | Atalanta v Juventus 14/01/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+5' Nicolo Zaniolo (Atalanta) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
90+5' Atalanta have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
90+4' Atalanta seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.

90+1' Chance! Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) comes within inches of scoring after picking up a pass from Samuel Mbangula, but his shot from inside the box flashes inches wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Atalanta will have a goal kick.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
90' Dangerous play by Isak Hien (Atalanta). Daniele Doveri blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick is awarded to Juventus.
87' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Nicolo Fagioli (Juventus) will replace Manuel Locatelli.
86' Samuel Mbangula (Juventus) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.
84' The corner is swung in but Atalanta can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

84' Nicolo Zaniolo (Atalanta) is the one to unleash a good effort towards the bottom right corner. His shot, however, is saved by the goalkeeper. What a save! Corner kick. Atalanta will have an opportunity.

83' What a save from Marco Carnesecchi! Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising header from close range towards the roof of the net, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant save to keep it out.
81' Substitution. Nicolas Gonzalez did his best and is replaced by Samuel Mbangula (Juventus).
81' Gian Piero Gasperini is forced to make a change. Giorgio Scalvini is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Isak Hien (Atalanta).
80' Gian Piero Gasperini decides to make a substitution. Ademola Lookman will be replaced by Nicolo Zaniolo (Atalanta).
80' The game is interrupted now, Giorgio Scalvini (Atalanta) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
78' 1 - 1 GOAL! Raoul Bellanova connects with a delightful cross and heads it towards Mateo Retegui (Atalanta), whose header goes past Michele Di Gregorio. 1:1.
75' Substitution. Douglas Luiz (Juventus) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Khephren Thuram walks off.
74' It must be a yellow card. It is. Sead Kolasinac (Atalanta) receives the caution after an awful tackle.
72' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) commits a rough challenge and Daniele Doveri blows his whistle for an infringement. Juventus are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
65' That's the end of the game for Davide Zappacosta, who is replaced by Raoul Bellanova (Atalanta).
65' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Mateo Retegui (Atalanta) replaces Charles De Ketelaere.
58' Daniele Doveri blows for a foul after Sead Kolasinac (Atalanta) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
55' Gian Piero Gasperini has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Lazar Samardzic replacing Mario Pasalic (Atalanta).

54' 0 - 1 GOAL! Superb work from Weston McKennie, who plays a vital role in the build-up. He squares it to Pierre Kalulu (Juventus), who beats Marco Carnesecchi with a brilliant shot into the bottom left corner. 0:1.

50' Mario Pasalic (Atalanta) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies narrowly wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Juventus.
50' Pierre Kalulu (Juventus) rises high to connect with the ball inside the six-yard box from the corner kick, but his decent header only hits the left post and ricochets away!
50' Juventus have a corner.

50' A nice individual effort by Federico Gatti (Juventus) comes to nothing as his shot is blocked on the edge of the box by a defender. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Juventus will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
48' Juventus failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

48' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) picks up a pass on the edge of the box and manages to get a powerful shot away, forcing the goalkeeper to scramble to his left and palm the ball away. The ball is out of play. Juventus win a corner kick.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Juventus comes to nothing.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Juventus was in an offside position.

44' Nicolas Gonzalez (Juventus) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies narrowly wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Atalanta will have a goal kick.
44' Weston McKennie (Juventus) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
43' Weston McKennie (Juventus) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
40' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post.
38' Matteo Ruggeri (Atalanta) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
37' Atalanta control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.

32' The corner is swung into the six-yard box and Giorgio Scalvini (Atalanta) gets his head on the ball, but he is unable to keep it down and it goes miles over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Juventus.
31' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
31' Daniele Doveri blows his whistle after Khephren Thuram (Juventus) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball. A free kick to Atalanta.
28' A long through ball into the box almost gives Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) a good chance, but he loses out to one of the defenders.
23' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) is flagged for offside.
20' Giorgio Scalvini (Atalanta) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
20' Giorgio Scalvini (Atalanta) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
16' Giorgio Scalvini (Atalanta) makes a slide tackle, but referee Daniele Doveri blows for a foul. Juventus earn a free kick.

15' Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) beats his man to the lofted pass, but his header sails harmlessly well wide of the right post from close range. The ball goes out of play and Juventus will have a goal kick.
11' Giorgio Scalvini (Atalanta) was too forceful with his tackle and Daniele Doveri interrupted the game to signal a free kick. A free kick has been awarded to Juventus.
10' Great teamplay by Atalanta as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
7' Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
7' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Juventus will take a free kick near the side line.
6' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
5' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
3' The game is interrupted as Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) is flagged offside.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Atalanta will kick-off.
Daniele Doveri is introduced as the referee for today's match.
